messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — we're starting Deprecation Wave B for legacy /v1 endpoints next week (6/1 -> 6/14). Primary goal: remove long-supported header-negotiation shim and flip client header to x-redwood-api-version.
Samir: Got it. Is the SDK header change backwards-compatible or will we need a shimming release? :thinking_face:
Priya: Mobile SDK can't add custom top-level headers until 1.3.0 (blocked on native networking PR). PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-mobile/pull/492
Jules: Infra note — our routing policy needs a canary window for 24h after each slice ramp. If rollouts exceed error budgets we auto-roll back.
Maya: Good call. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 72h with 24h canary checks. If errors > 1.5x baseline, rollback.
Samir: Who owns the SDK changes & releases? I can own core SDK (js/py) releases. Priya can take mobile.
Priya: I'm on mobile ownership but need an ETA for the native PR merge. Current target EOD Friday. If it slips we should postpone mobile switch.
Li: Telemetry ask — please add a stable tag api_version for every request so we can slice durability/regressions. Current tracing uses header_name: redwood-version which will change.
Maya: Li, good call. Make the new tag api_version (values: v1, v2). Add mapping in the ingest layer for historical continuity.
Tom: Quick question on deprecation messaging to customers: do we send in-app notices or only email? Marketing prefers both for enterprise accounts.
Maya: Both for enterprise + in-app banner for self-serve. Support has prepared a FAQ draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/v1-deprec-faq (please review).
Samir: SDK snippet we'll publish:
```
// JS example
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-api-version': '2', 'Authorization': 'Bearer <key>' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input })
})
```
Maya: We'll coordinate staged SDK releases. Samir — can you cut a js/py patch by Thursday morning so docs + quickstarts align?
Samir: Yep, cutting patches Thu AM. I'll add a feature flag SKIP_V1_SHIM to toggle in CI for the first canary slice.
Jules: DeployBot scheduled canary for 6/2 02:00 UTC. DeployBot: Canary job queued — canary-id=canary-3824579, slices=[0.1,0.5,1.0], rollback-policy=auto-on-error-threshold.
DeployBot: Job started (canary-3824579). Logs -> https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary-3824579
Priya: If mobile native PR doesn't merge by Fri EOD, I'll push mobile to second wave (after 50% ramp) and we keep v1 for mobile until 6/14.
Maya: That adjustment makes sense. Documenting owners: Samir (core SDK + docs), Priya (mobile SDK), Jules (infra & rollout automation), Li (telemetry + tracing), Tom (customer comms coordination).
Tom: I'll schedule customer comms for Wed morning. Will ping legal for wording approval.
Li: One more: please add a metric tag 'compat_path' with values 'shim' or 'native' for initial month so we can measure shim usage.
Maya: Done — adding to rollout checklist. Action items: Samir -> SDK patches Thu AM; Priya -> merge PR or confirm delay Fri EOD; Jules -> ensure auto-rollback thresholds in place; Li -> telemetry tags live before canary; Tom -> comms draft Wed.
Samir: I'll post the SDK release notes and changelog link here when done. :shipit:
Priya: Noted. I'll update this thread when native PR merges.
Jules: Watching build & deploy logs, will report canary health at +1h and +24h.
Tom: Thanks all, keeping this async unless blockers crop up. :pray:
